title: Meta's Muse agent gives every user a full cloud computer running Ubuntu Linux
summary: Meta gives every Muse user a free cloud computer running Ubuntu Linux where they can install software, write code, and browse the web. A "Sentinel" process monitors sensitive actions outside the user's workspace, while users can inspect every file in the system. With over 500,000 users in its first week, Meta is betting on product reach over model power.
